about: The Dev team's record of how Myseed Ops was built: projects, milestones, sprints, releases and tasks, from the roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md) and the git history. src/server/dev-history.ts adds what is missing when the server starts (and with npm run dev:history); it never changes or removes what is already in the app. Tasks: [code, title, type, points, start date, done date, release, description]. Maintenance tasks are objects with their status.

owner.name: Kidus
owner.note: Every task is assigned to the Dev account whose name starts with Kidus (the Developer role preferred), or MYSEED_DEV_OWNER_EMAIL when set.

sprints.name: Sprint 1
sprints.goal: The production workflow, departments, HR, Finance, attendance, the Dev studio and the platform's foundations, and the first deploy to the VPS.
sprints.review: Every committed task was finished and released in 0.1.0, 0.2.0 and 0.3.0: the production workflow end to end, every department with its own flow, HR, Finance, attendance with face and QR check-in, the Dev studio, presentations, the assistant, customer support, and the Hostinger VPS with auto deploy from GitHub.

sprints.name: Sprint 2
sprints.goal: Updates 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2: Noor and Chapa in full, the customer support and contact center platform, and Fun mode with Seed Town.
sprints.review: Every committed task was finished and released in 1.0.0 to 1.4.0: Update 1.0 (8 phases), Update 1.1 (phases 10 to 16), Update 1.2 (10 phases), Noor protection, the watchdog, UI styles, Fun mode and Seed Town with the guest arcade and the Windows app.

sprints.name: Sprint 3
sprints.goal: Documentation and the Dev team's way of working; confirm Chapa and Noor on the live system; maintenance as it is requested.

sprints.name: Sprint 4
sprints.goal: SchoolHub on CI and staging, Transaction Verify's first certified methods and restore drill, the website's SEO fixes and content.

sprints.name: Sprint 5
sprints.goal: Website two-step sign-in and migrations; SchoolHub self-hosted drill and provider accounts; Transaction Verify phone audit and settings.

sprints.name: Sprint 6
sprints.goal: SchoolHub pilot readiness; Transaction Verify launch gate and penetration test.

releases.name: v0.1.0
releases.notes: First release. Admin data control, the editorial workflow with handovers and checklists, team chat, email from the app, departments with configurable statuses, views, dashboards and requests, calls with the app's own ringing, HR, Finance, attendance with face and QR check-in, and the foundations: sign-in policy, scheduled jobs, backups, tests in CI and errors in the app.

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes: The platform grows: department flows, the Dev studio, the presentation studio, the assistant, the company inbox, passkeys, Myseed's own needs, performance management, customer support with browser calls, strategic planning, the document library, Office, Power BI and Notion, Admin platform pages, phone layouts, and the control panel with the Hostinger VPS and auto deploy.

releases.name: v0.3.0
releases.notes: Noor, Chapa and integrations: the Legacy CMS reading Noor, Chapa for several businesses, i-Conic SMS, several AI providers, email providers, Google sign-in, kiosk pairing and QR fixes.

releases.name: Update 1.0
releases.notes: Update 1.0, phases 1 to 8: sticky curriculum context and kiosk access, the date-first Legacy CMS, Chapa for every business with follow-up, one help menu with the Telegram Mini App, assistant v2 in Amharic, My work for everyone, the integrations hub with SMS routing, and six colour themes.

releases.name: Update 1.1
releases.notes: Update 1.1, phases 10 to 16: connected systems, live chat, the Telegram bot manager, the call center, the knowledge base and the live admin dashboard.

releases.name: Update 1.2
releases.notes: Update 1.2: Chapa sync that fetches everything, the Chapa transactions screen, the Noor field registry and filtering, support content and the Telegram bot, support chat at team-chat level, Customer Support Requests, calling, the IVR and call records; department data managers; Next.js 16.4.6.

releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Support, Noor and operations hardening: Noor admin pages and the academic content manager, Noor protection, the external API and SMS consoles, the Mini App redesign, agent ratings, the watchdog and memory cap, and the assistant's autopilot.

releases.name: v1.4.0
releases.notes: The support desk like Team chat, UI styles and Fun mode, the Redo status, the V/E/D/U permission grid and the Assistant Manager role, Seed Town as a city with licensed cars, the guest arcade, Seed Core, football and the Windows app.

releases.name: v1.5.0
releases.notes: Specs and docs as formatted company documents, Markdown kept as written, the project's documentation and the Dev team handbook in the library, and Seed Town Offline.
